messages:
Jen: quick q — where's the canonical spot for TTFT p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec? I'm triaging a customer perf report and need the dashboards + runbook links. Also thinking we should tweak the p99 alert, pinging @Sam :eyes:

Sam: short answer: Grafana TTFT overview + traces in Jaeger. Links below. For alerts we use alerts repo -> prometheus rules. What threshold are you seeing?

Jen: p99 around 950ms for a sustained 10m window, tokens/sec drops to ~40% of baseline for the model route. Customer seeing timeouts at 1s on hosted API.

Alex: dashboard links (copying from bookmarks):
- TTFT overview: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/TTFT_OVERVIEW/ttft-overview?orgId=1
- Tokens & Throughput: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/TOKENS/tokens-throughput?orgId=1
- Per-route latency: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/ROUTES/route-latency?orgId=1
- Jaeger traces: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/search

Sam: useful queries:
```
# tokens per second (global)
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m]))

# tokens per second by model
sum by (model) (rate(tokens_generated_total[1m]))

# p95 request duration (seconds)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, route))

# TTFT p99 approximation (tail of request duration)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, route))
```

Maria: runbook & alert locations:
- Runbook: https://docs.internal.redwood/runbooks/ttft-investigation
- Alert rules: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/monitoring/tree/prometheus/rules

Sam: for the immediate customer case I'd suggest temporarily adjusting the p99 alert severity/threshold while we dig in. Current rule: `ttft_p99_route_high` fires at > 800ms for 5m. If your customer is at ~950ms for 10m we can: lower the alert window or raise the threshold depending on impact.

Jen: can we raise threshold to 1.2s for that route only and put it into a maintenance window? prefer route-level override rather than global change.

Alex: policy is to avoid raising thresholds globally. We have per-route silences via alertmanager: create a silence scoped to `route=\"customer-xyz\"` for 2h and add a note. I'll create the silence if you confirm.

Jen: please create it, note \"investigating customer-xyz elevated p99\". Also can someone paste the exact alert rule snippet to propose the per-route override for later?

Sam: alert rule (example you can copy):
```
- alert: TTFT_P99_High_PerRoute
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, route)) > 1.2
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: \"TTFT p99 > 1.2s for {{ $labels.route }}\"
    runbook: \"https://docs.internal.redwood/runbooks/ttft-investigation\"
```

Alex: created silence for route=\"customer-xyz\" for 2h. ID: 9a3f. Note added. ops-oncall, fyi.

ops-oncall: acked. Will watch for any page. If it flaps we escalate.

Maria: some quick checks while you triage:
- Check prefix/KV cache hit rate on that route (Grafana panel on TTFT overview). Low cache hits often spike TTFT.
- Check model variant fallback logs (Kibana path: https://logs.internal.redwood/app/kibana#/discover) for `fallback_to_quantized` or `serve_unavailable` entries.
- Look at GPU utilization for dedicated pools (metrics: `gpu_utilization` by host).

Jen: looked at cache hit — it's ~12% (baseline 65%). That explains tokens/sec drop as many requests hit cold path and generate extra tokens. Any quick mitigation?

Sam: two quick mitigations: 1) enable route-level short-term cache warmup (toggle in config), 2) serve from a warmed model variant (pin to non-evicting instance). Both require ops change; which do you want?

Jen: try cache warmup first. If you can flip for customer-xyz for 30m and monitor tokens/sec, that'd be great.

Alex: I'll flip warmup flag and post update.

monitoring-bot: AlertManager: Silence created for TTFT_P99_High (scope route=customer-xyz) by alex — expires in 2h.

Alex: warmup toggle flipped at 1872500300. Tokens/sec climbed back to ~85% of baseline within 90s. p99 dropped to ~420ms after warmup completed.

Jen: awesome, thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Sam to open PR for per-route alert variant + doc the default thresholds, Alex to add a dashboard panel showing cache-hit vs tokens/sec correlation, Maria to add steps to runbook about warmup toggle. I'll stitch into the customer postmortem.

Sam: filing PR now: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/monitoring/pull/412 — adding per-route TTFT alert and notes.

Alex: adding dashboard panel next. ETA EOD.

Maria: I'll update runbook after verification.

Jen: thanks all :thumbsup:
